title: Botany genetics M3C: harvest mutation runtime and generic produce (R7 fresh gate)
acceptance_criteria: Resolved 27-entry ChangeHarvest uses no effect RNG; immutable modes progress NO_REPEAT→REPEAT→SELF→SELF and survive profile copy.
Ordinary 15s cycle self-harvests only ready, living plants after health; current produce age applies and failed attempts remain retryable.
Zero yield gives auto-harvest ≥1 but manual may give 0; shared retention keeps REPEAT/SELF and clears NO_REPEAT.
Shared factory publishes tray-position batches with staging, one commit/compensation, current loaded source, block collision checks, and valid pile co-location.
Native tests cover six outputs, repeat/zero-yield, normal ticks, and exact-component multi-output, blocked, and stale pre-source-commit batches.

Generic produce uses IReagentTrait/resolved profile, preserves food priority, distinguishes zero/missing source, replaces contents, initializes source once, adds genetic capacity eagerly, and never refills/overfills depleted or partial source.
Generic evidence claims no nonfood leaf registration; full 71-entry catalog and every mutation remain required beyond this gate.
Native checks verify source-correct A NO-REPEAT/B REPEAT/C SELF sign text, association, bounded footprint, and protected room; visual readability is manual.
Report focused evidence and full-suite/catalog, visual/client, and owner-acceptance limits; technical ready_for_owner is possible, owner acceptance is not inferred.
Main, JVM-test, and native sources compile and runtime jar is produced.
manual_steps: Run `/ms14 botany_fixture` to build the revised test bench; read the physical A/B/C signs. These preset modes compare behavior, not random mutation, and are not the full catalog.
At A (NO-REPEAT), use the ordinary empty-hand right-click/USE harvest interaction described by the station sign; expect the source plant to clear.
At B (REPEAT), use the same ordinary empty-hand right-click/USE harvest interaction; expect the same plant to remain.
At C (SELF), do not interact; wait about 15 seconds. Expect fruit to appear near the tray as a world item while the plant remains. This is not fruit placed in tray inventory.
